summary: Package ships an unexplained Windows PE binary with a self-labeled 'virus' name but no auto-execution
details: The tarball contains a 455 KB Windows PE64 executable named DakuMangalSingh.exe (sha256 368320791e5c022ffabedb44eae6ca902fe3f524754a085b726617c2006dc791) alongside a zero-byte index.js. package.json declares no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare lifecycle scripts and its main entry is empty, so neither npm install nor require() of the package causes the binary to be executed, decoded, or written elsewhere. The package name self-labels as a virus, and no documentation, source, or purpose is provided for the shipped binary. Installing or importing this package in a normal npm pipeline does not run the executable; harm would only occur if a user were separately induced to launch DakuMangalSingh.exe on a Windows host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
